thoughts: The current Blueprint layout successfully captures the technical spirit of Bluetone, but the dwell time of 10s suggests users are meticulously scanning but perhaps feeling overwhelmed by the density of the 2x2 blocks. To optimize, I am shifting to a FORENSIC_GRID strategy. This introduces a sophisticated 'system diagnostic' feel that better separates metadata from core benefits. I am enhancing the contrast of the key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure the 98.7% and 100% metrics pop immediately. The visual code is refined to include micro-interactions on the data-tier-ids to improve tactile engagement, and I have balanced the alignment to complement the center-aligned hero while maintaining the technical edge of the monospaced typography.
